policy: Every original regular file must map exactly once to repository source, reviewed artifact or explicit exclusion/quarantine. No silent omissions, no repository sharding to evade quotas, no Actions/LFS/Codespaces billing. Staging is excluded from recursion. No inherited workflow is placed in the new root .github/workflows.
